published_as: Local APK for owner verification; coordinator publishes the Release
supersedes: 1.9.5 (same 55-chaplet engine; Saint Rita entry replaced by the Londrina five-decade rosary)
changes: Replaced the old Catholic Doors 9-bead chaplet in santa-rita-coronilla with the five-decade Terço de Santa Rita de Cássia published by the Santuário de Londrina, adapted faithfully to ES/EN.

24 step definitions now expand to 71 guided prayers: offering, Creed, Our Father, three Hail Marys, Glory, five mysteries with ten aspirations each, consecration, final invocation and Sign of the Cross.
One full prayer per bead; no V/R invented where the source has no dialogue; source typo preserved in Portuguese and documented in notes.
known_limitations: Owner must confirm on a physical phone.
